verdict.rationale: DBOS ships as an open-source library: the official Python SDK is installed with `pip install dbos`, published on GitHub as dbos-transact-py, and documented with programming guides, tutorials, and API references, including the DBOSClient for external code. It also has official integrations with the OpenAI Agents SDK and Vercel AI. A hands-on user praised the Python SDK's ergonomics, and community comments confirm TypeScript is supported too. Missing for 10: first-party TypeScript SDK docs in the pack (only Python and a Vercel AI page are shown), and SDKs beyond Python and TypeScript (users note there is no .NET support).
